newsitem.title: UK: Frost Grp finance director quits, volumes up.
newsitem.headline: Frost Grp finance director quits, volumes up.

text.p: Petroleum products retailer Frost Group Plc said on Wednesday its finance director Vasant Bhuva is to leave the company by mutual agreement and resign as a director from November 1.
The group also said sales volumes have picked up strongly in August and September and its trading is now in line or ahead of expectations.

Frost, which last month reported a 33 percent drop in first half profits, said four recent price rises imposed by major oil companies appeared to have held so far, allowing it to increase its competitiveness.

The group, estimated to be Britain's fourth biggest motor fuels retailer by numbers of sites after Esso, Shell and BP, said last month it believed fierce price competition in the retail petrol market was becoming less intense.
Frost said managing director John Murgatroyd would be acting finance director until it found a replacement for Bhuva.
